notes: Small update to the shared look; nothing changes for you here.
Lists, dialogs and settings pages move smoothly, and a to-do folds away the same way.
Switches and tabs slide to what you pick.
The number of to-dos left counts to its new value, and a to-do you drag settles into its place.
Buttons have a little depth and feel pressed when you click them.
Checkboxes, toggles and options animate when you pick them, and folding sections open smoothly.
Delete group asks with a trash icon and a Close button in the corner.
Menus and tooltips open out of the spot they belong to, and buttons dip a little when you press them.
Dropdowns where you pick a value show an up-and-down arrow.
Text fields and dropdowns look calmer in Dark mode.
Press Enter while editing a to-do to start a new one right below it. Its ⋯ menu can add a to-do below or a sub-to-do too.
Live view settings open in a big window: pick a font and size, bold, text color, outline and background color.
Choose what sits between groups in the live view (nothing, a line or the group name) and whether finished to-dos show, ticked and struck through.
Patch notes for this module start with this version.
